name: 1541HUD Fire-24G Control - DolphinDOS C/A/E
description: ROM-free CLI template for a three-page C/A/E installation, including DolphinDOS-style ROM sets. Supply lawful 8 KiB pages under private-roms/control/.
notes: Three-page C/A/E layout: C000-DFFF, A000-BFFF via X1/Y5, then E000-FFFF via X2/Y7. Use only where that wiring exists. This template does not require a RAMBoard by itself; it requires the documented A-page decode wiring. SEL_B reset is LOW for 350 ms then input through 1 kOhm to C46+/CR7; SEL_A IEC address; SEL_C write-protect override; SEL_D sense. Duplicate the final multi-ROM entry locally for additional legally held ROM sets.
